title: Kamishiro Rui — Piqued Curiosity〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Shunmeiza - Production Office

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Production Associate
rows.Line: ...and that about covers it. The production team is involved in just about every essential part of any given play.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Between scheduling, budgeting, meeting with the other teams, creating flyers, running the ticket office on the day of the performances, lunch catering...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You have quite a lot to do.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Production Associate
rows.Line: It is. Things do get a little hectic sometimes... But they're all things that need to be taken care of in order for a show to succeed.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Production Associate
rows.Line: We feel a great sense of responsibility knowing that what we do determines whether or not we're going to be one hundred percent ready to deliver on the day.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Production Associate
rows.Line: So, whenever the audience goes home smiling...

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Production Associate
rows.Line: Not only the actors and the director, but we also get to feel proud of what we accomplished!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It sounds like you love your job very much.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Production Associate
rows.Line: I do! Seeing the audience smile and have fun fills me with the same satisfaction that the actors and directors feel!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Seeing the audience smile...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Our visit with the production team was really fun!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it was nice to see how passionate they all were about what they do. I'm very much looking forward to our next stop now.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Prop Designer
rows.Line:
Wait!
Please watch your step. There's an unfinished prop by your feet.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh no! We're sorry!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This looks like...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Pardon me, but is this a novel that will be in the protagonist's home during the next show?

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Prop Designer
rows.Line: Hm? Yes, that's right...

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Prop Designer
rows.Line:
Oh, aren't you two here visiting us?
We heard that you were interested in how the production process works and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, we're from the troupe Wonderlands×Showtime.
My name is Rui Kamishiro. It's a pleasure to meet you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm Emu Otori! It's nice to meet you!

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Prop Designer
rows.Line: Yes, nice to meet you both.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm the director for our troupe and also make quite a lot of our props. As such, I'm very interested in seeing how you make yours.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If it's alright with you, would you mind telling us more about your creative process?

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Prop Designer
rows.Line:
I don't mind.
I was actually just about to go on break.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Prop Designer
rows.Line: Still, I'm amazed that you could tell this prop was for the next show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It felt like something that would be in the protagonist's house...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A starving novelist desperately working to finish his manuscript next to a disordered pile of books...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This truly felt like one of those books.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Prop Designer
rows.Line: You mean that? I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Prop Designer
rows.Line: Our job as designers is to make the audience believe that everything on stage is the real thing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The real thing...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Then, this book has certainly accomplished that...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (When I initially saw it, I didn't see it as a prop.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I simply saw it as a book from that novelist's house.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
This really is remarkable...
Every crease and stain looks so real...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It has me imagining Kishi spilling a drink near it at one point in time.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, I thought that too!
I thought about him panicking and trying to clean it up in a really big hurry!

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Prop Designer
rows.Line: Hehe. It means a lot to hear how much of an image it conjured up.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Prop Designer
rows.Line: As you both described, creases and stains like these can flesh out the setting of a play...

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Prop Designer
rows.Line: And that's why, even if the audience doesn't see every little prop, we don't want to cut any corners.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The devil is in the details, yes?

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Prop Designer
rows.Line:
Exactly.
Yes, it can be hard sometimes...

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Prop Designer
rows.Line: But the things we make elevate the actors' performance, and seeing the audience at the edge of their seats makes all that fatigue go away.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Prop Designer
rows.Line: In other words, we do everything we can for our actors and the audience.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For the actors and the audience...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (They're incredible. Not just their artistic skills...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (They care about the details. They passionately want to bring the characters to life and entertain their audience. That much is clear.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This is what it means to be a true professional...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I hope I get to create sets and props with artisans like these someday.)
